items.title: US large-cap dividend hike watch: 10 stocks with the longest growth streaks
items.summary: Investing.com -- This screen looks for US large caps (market cap above $10B) with a yield above 2%, a payout ratio below 60%, and dividend growth above 5%. They also need more than 5 straight years of increases. 47 stocks matched, and the table shows the 10 with the longest streaks. A low payout ratio means the company keeps room to raise the dividend again.

items.title: Spotify Rallies on Subscribers; Hermès falls on China Sales | Stock Movers
items.summary:
- Shares of Procter & Gamble (PG) moved higher ahead of the US market open after the company's sales and profits beat Wall Street expectations. Organic revenue rose 4% in the first quarter, the fastest growth in three years. 
- Shares of Spotify (SPOT) rallied after results and forecast spoke to improving margin trends. Spotify reported that the service's paying subscribers increased 2% to hit 306 million in the third quarter, topping Wall Street estimates of 305.1 million. 
- Hermès (RMS FP) reported disappointing sales in the third quarter on sluggish demand in China. Their 41% slump so far this year puts them on track for the worst annual performance since the company listed in 1993.
- Shares of Lam Research (LRCX) fell in premarket trading after the semiconductor capital equipment company gave a forecast for adjusted second-quarter earnings slightly weaker than expected.
